# SSMConnect

> SSMConnect is a free, open-source app for Windows and Linux. It finds AWS EC2 servers and opens SSH and Remote Desktop connections through AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, so inbound port 22 stays closed and no bastion host is needed.

For the full list of pages in Markdown, see https://poonchezhian.github.io/sitemap.md. For a plain answer to what SSMConnect is and how to install it, see https://poonchezhian.github.io/index.md.

## Pages

- [SSMConnect home](https://poonchezhian.github.io/index.md): what it does, how it works, what a server needs, Linux install, safety notes and FAQ
- [SSH into EC2 over SSM from Windows with PuTTY](https://poonchezhian.github.io/guides/ssh-ec2-ssm-putty/index.md): step-by-step manual setup, with fixes for common errors

## Project

- [Source code and downloads](https://github.com/poonchezhian/ssmconnect): Apache-2.0, Windows installer and signed Linux packages
- [Documentation](https://github.com/poonchezhian/ssmconnect/wiki): setup and troubleshooting
